home.heading: Shopify + Cloudflare scaffold
home.runtimeBody: This app runs in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. Sessions live in KV, app state lives in D1 via Drizzle, and both are real bindings in local dev as well as production.
home.installMissing: No install row in D1 yet — it is written when OAuth completes.

feedback.heading: We're new, and we're listening
feedback.body: This app is just getting started, and we ship fast based on what merchants tell us. Something missing, something broken, or an idea that would make your day easier? Send it our way.
feedback.action: Share feedback or request a feature

empty.heading: No tickets yet
empty.body: When something looks wrong or you want a feature, open a ticket and we will reply here.

form.heading: What can we help with?
form.category: What kind of issue is this?
form.subject: Subject
form.bodyHelp: What you expected, what happened instead, and where. A screenshot or recording helps most.
form.emailHelp: We reply here as well as in the app. Clear it to only be notified in the app.
form.ccHelp: They get every reply, and can reply themselves. Up to {{max}}.

thread.replyPlaceholder: Add anything else that might help
thread.closedNotice: This ticket is closed. Reply to reopen it.

errors.rate_limited: You have sent a lot of messages just now. Try again in a minute.
errors.empty_reply: Write a message or attach a file.
errors.upload_failed: That file could not be uploaded. Try again.
errors.unsupported_type: Only images and videos can be attached.
errors.invalid_cc: That copy list is not valid. Use one email address per line.
errors.invalid_cc_email: That does not look like an email address.
errors.duplicate_cc_email: That address is already on the list.
errors.too_many_cc_emails: The list is full. Remove someone to add another.
